top_signals.summary:

The Japanese doomsday cult responsible for the 1995 Tokyo sarin attack had money, facilities, scientifically educated members, and a leadership willing to cause mass harm. alerts.title: U.S. natural gas inventories end injection season above normal levels
alerts.summary: Working natural gas in storage in the Lower 48 states ended the natural gas injection season at 3,810 billion cubic feet (Bcf), exceeding the five-year average by almost 2%, according to estimates based on data from our Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report released on November 12. Injection season runs April 1–October 31, the months of typically lower natural gas demand.
